metadata.description: Web page reader for agents: GET /read?url=<public http(s) URL> returns the page as ready-to-use text — title, paragraph blocks, word count — with script, style, noscript, svg, iframe and all markup removed and a fixed 12,000-character cap reported honestly in `truncated`. What makes it worth paying for instead of fetching it yourself: the same deterministic Indonesian entity dictionary and sentiment lexicon behind /feed and /sentiment run on the extracted text (score plus the matched terms, no LLM, no invented number — a page the lexicon cannot read returns sentiment null with the reason in source_note). Safety is part of the product: the hostname is resolved by us and refused if ANY A/AAAA answer is loopback, RFC1918, CGNAT, link-local, cloud-metadata or reserved; the connection then goes to that validated IP with the name used only as SNI and Host, so DNS rebinding has no second lookup to exploit; redirects are never followed (3xx comes back as redirect_blocked plus the Location); the body is cut at 1.5 MB and refused above 2 MB; only text/html, text/plain, text/markdown, application/json and application/xml are parsed; no inbound header is forwarded and nothing is stored. $0.05 USDC per call via x402 or MPP, no signup, no API key.

metadata.description: A-share earnings express reports (业绩快报): the preliminary numbers a company itself publishes weeks before the full quarterly or annual report, for every mainland listing that filed one. Each row carries operating revenue, net profit attributable to shareholders, basic EPS, net asset value per share, weighted-average ROE, both figures for the same period last year, and the year-on-year growth in revenue and in net profit — plus the report period, its quarter label, the board, the industry, the notice date and whether the row is that company's latest revision. Pair it with /cn/earnings-forecast: the forecast is what management expects, the express report is what the books already say. Pass ?symbol=600519 for one stock's history, ?report=2026-09-30 to pin a fiscal period, ?date=2026-10-13 for one disclosure day, ?sort=notice|revenue|profit|roe|growth to rank, ?direction=asc to flip the order, and ?limit=1-300. Chinese vendors publish these as per-company announcement pages; there is no clean market-wide feed. 中文：A股业绩快报——营业收入、归母净利润、每股收益、每股净资产、加权ROE与营收/净利同比增速。 No API key and no signup: call the endpoint, it answers HTTP 402 with the payment terms, pay per request in USDC on Base with any x402-compatible client or wallet, then retry the same request to get the data.

metadata.description: A-share earnings pre-announcements (业绩预告) from the official disclosure stream: for each company you get the forecast type (预增 big rise / 预减 big fall / 略增 slight rise / 略减 slight fall / 扭亏 back to profit / 首亏 first loss / 续盈 / 续亏 / 不确定), the year-on-year change range in percent, the forecast amount range in yuan, the previous year's same-period figure, the notice date, the report period, the full announcement text and management's stated reason. Newest disclosure first and the net-profit metric by default, so the top of the list is what was just published. Pass ?report=2026-09-30 to pin a fiscal period, ?type=预增 to filter by forecast type, ?symbol=600519 for one stock, ?sort=change to rank by forecast growth, or ?metric=all to include revenue forecasts as well. Earnings pre-announcements move Chinese stocks more than almost any other scheduled disclosure, and this is the cleanest machine-readable view of the whole market at once. 中文：A股业绩预告——预告类型（预增/预减/扭亏/首亏…）、同比变动区间、预计金额、公告日、预告原文与变动原因。 No API key and no signup: call the endpoint, it answers HTTP 402 with the payment terms, pay per request in USDC on Base with any x402-compatible client or wallet, then retry the same request to get the data.

items.description: Trace a raster image into an SVG vector: color (vtracer) or black-and-white (potrace); input up to 15 MB, traced at up to 1024 px. Returns a download URL valid for 1 hour, plus the SVG markup inline when it is 100 KB or less (otherwise svg is null)

example.svg:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg version="1.1" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="288" height="288">
<path d="M0 0 C2.4 0.01 4.8 0 7.2 -0.01 ..." fill="#3A73A4" transform="translate(139,32)"/>
...</svg>

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a png, jpeg, webp, gif, tiff or avif image (logos and icons trace best)

mode.description: color (default) or bw for a black-and-white trace

threshold.description: bw only: 1-254, pixels darker than this become black, default 128
